reason: Provides a DSH-to-browser bridge for explicitly authorized Chrome tabs, enabling structured page inspection, interaction, navigation, and debugging within an existing development conversation.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 开发对话连接到用户显式授权的 Chrome 标签页，以便检查、操作、导航和调试真实页面。
summaries.en: Connects DSH development conversations to explicitly authorized Chrome tabs for structured page inspection, interaction, navigation, and debugging.

capabilities: Read DOM, accessibility content, styles, geometry, console errors, failed network requests, and screenshots
Interact with pages through clicks, typing, form filling, selection, focus, keyboard input, hovering, and scrolling
Navigate, refresh, wait for page conditions, and operate through Chrome debugger sessions
Bridge browser evidence and actions into a DSH development conversation
